messages: anya: Linkcheck spiked on main after the slugify v2 roll; two broken fragments reported: /migration#runtime-config and /sdk/python#embed-sample sam: which PR changed slugify? i can triage quickly. anya: PR 2831. Linkcheck output attached in CI. li: quick peek — built HTML uses a nonbreaking hyphen in the generated ids (e.g. `runtime‑config`) so ASCII-fragment links 404. seen this before with emoji slugs. harry: options: add explicit MDX ids, update all literal links, or add temporary aliases in the generated HTML. MDX ids might be rewritten again depending on pipeline order. anya: i'll open a small patch adding explicit `{#runtime-config}` and `{#embed-sample}` to the two source files + linkcheck test fixtures. preview-bot: Preview for PR 2840 created: https://deploy-preview-2840--redwood-docs.netlify.app linkcheck-bot: Running linkcheck on preview... -> FAIL: fragments not found (runtime-config, embed-sample) li: preview confirmed — explicit ids were normalized to use U+2011 by the slugify step during build, so they don't match ASCII anchors. harry: pragmatic fix: inject ASCII alias anchors into the generated HTML during preview builds only. i'll sketch a tiny Node script that scans for headings with U+2011 and inserts before them. anya: sounds good. add a 14-day whitelist for these failing fragments to avoid CI churn, and file an infra ticket to reorder processors longer-term. sam: filed INFRA-1302 to reorder remark-id vs slugify and added tests. harry: injector added to preview pipeline on the PR branch; rerunning linkcheck. linkcheck-bot: Rerun -> PASS anya: merging patch now since preview is green. follow-ups: audit commonly-linked pages for literal fragment URLs, and remove injector after INFRA-1302 lands. sam: i'll take the audit scope (top 25 pages) and open follow-up PRs for code-block examples with literal links. anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
